parsed.format: Bilingual translation drill and app recommendation
parsed.visual_overview: An anime-style animation showing two children, a girl and a boy, walking down a suburban street. The girl speaks in Hindi, and the boy translates her sentences into English. The visual then transitions to UI overlays showing the app's features and pricing, ending with a 3D smartphone displaying the final install CTA.

scenes.script_native:
Priya says: मैं स्कूल जा रही हूँ।
Rahul says: I am going to school.
Priya says: आज मैं स्कूल जाकर Maths पढूँगी।
Rahul says: Today, I will go to school and study maths.
scenes.script_roman:
Priya says: Main school jaa rahi hoon.
Rahul says: I am going to school.
Priya says: Aaj main school jaakar Maths padhungi.
Rahul says: Today, I will go to school and study maths.

scenes.script_native:
Priya says: मेरे लंच में मेरी माँ ने tasty खाना डाला है।
Rahul says: My mother has packed tasty food in my lunch.
scenes.script_roman:
Priya says: Mere lunch mein meri maa ne tasty khaana daala hai.
Rahul says: My mother has packed tasty food in my lunch.

scenes.script_native:
Priya says: वाह! तुम्हारी English तो बहुत अच्छी है। ये तुमने कहाँ से सीखी?
Rahul says: वो मैंने Supernova AI app से सीखी।
Priya says: Supernova AI? वो क्या है?
scenes.script_roman:
Priya says: Waah! Tumhari English toh bahut achhi hai. Ye tumne kahan se seekhi?
Rahul says: Wo maine Supernova AI app se seekhi.
Priya says: Supernova AI? Wo kya hai?

scenes.script_native: Rahul says: इस app में एक AI teacher हैं, जो बिना judgement के English बोलने की practice करवाती हैं। और कोई mistake हुई तो तुरंत correct करके Hindi में समझाती हैं।
scenes.script_roman: Rahul says: Is app mein ek AI teacher hain, jo bina judgement ke English bolne ki practice karwati hain. Aur koi mistake hui toh turant correct karke Hindi mein samjhati hain.

scenes.script_native:
Priya says: वाह! पर ये app तो महँगा होगा ना?
Rahul says: बिलकुल नहीं। ये offline coaching से सात गुना सस्ता है। और 1 crore+ users already practice कर रहे हैं।
scenes.script_roman:
Priya says: Waah! Par ye app toh mehenga hoga na?
Rahul says: Bilkul nahi. Ye offline coaching se saat guna sasta hai. Aur 1 crore+ users already practice kar rahe hain.

scenes.script_native:
Priya says: Wow! Amazing! फिर शुरू कैसे करूँ?
Rahul says: Install button पे click करो, Supernova AI download करो, और सिर्फ 30 days में अपनी English improve करो।
scenes.script_roman:
Priya says: Wow! Amazing! Phir shuru kaise karun?
Rahul says: Install button pe click karo, Supernova AI download karo, aur sirf 30 days mein apni English improve karo.

scenes.script_native: Unknown speaker says: अभी install button पे click करो और Supernova AI download करो।
